p0006_1.t: Households Surveyed: Planned, Collected and by Length of Residence
p0006_1.d: Households planned for the survey and collected, with a breakdown by length of residence, by area (survey of 1937).

p0009_1.t: Retail Distribution in Tokyo City by Type of Distribution Outlet
p0009_1.d: Number of establishments (and markets), sales in yen and percentage share by type of distribution outlet in Tokyo City (1932 basis).

p0010_1.t: Share of Retail Distribution by Type of Outlet and Commodity (Percentages)
p0010_1.d: Percentage of retail sales of each commodity group (rice, seasonings, fuel, sundries, confectionery, fish, fruit and vegetables, meat, drapery, Western goods, footwear, others) by type of distribution outlet, Tokyo City (1932 basis).

p0011_1.t: Use of Distribution Outlets by Households (Part 1)
p0011_1.d: Number of households using each type of distribution outlet and its ratio to all households, for the total and for the Shamisenbori and Yodobashi market areas (survey of 1937).

p0011_2.t: Comparison of Market Sales: Shamisenbori Municipal Market and Yodobashi Market
p0011_2.d: Annual sales, sales per shop per year and average daily market sales in yen for the two markets, by year (1935 and 1936).

p0011_3.t: Daily Average Market Attendance and Purchases per Person
p0011_3.d: Average daily number of visitors and purchase per person in sen for the two markets, by period.

p0012_1.t: Use of Distribution Outlets by Households (Part 2) (Percentages)
p0012_1.d: Percentage of households by combination of outlet types used (retail shops, public and private markets, department stores, stalls and pedlars, cooperatives), by market area (survey of 1937).

p0013_1.t: Dependence on Each Distribution Outlet by Commodity (Part 1)
